stories.title: Explainer-What is the polar vortex and what could it mean for winter?
stories.summary: The polar vortex can refer to two different weather systems: the stratospheric polar vortex and the tropospheric polar vortex. Of current interest is the stratospheric one, a ring of strong west-to-east winds that circles and helps trap extremely cold air above the Arctic, around 10 to 50 km above the Earth’s surface.
